book.name: MATTHEW
book.title: Id ash d Matthew Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Mash g ge Jiawul am chum s‑wuimk g Jesus pi apꞌekam ch ed
Sh g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag hab hahawa ahg g Jesus mat gam hu hejelko wo hih mo am d tohono jewed matsh wo e aꞌappe. Tsh heg hekaj gam hu hih g Jesus
k am haꞌichugkahim giꞌikko wehst‑mahm tash ab pi haꞌichu koꞌadch nash pi e hoꞌigeꞌidahun ab Jiosh wui.
Kutsh ab wui jiwia g jijawul ha‑geꞌejig am chum s‑wuimk pi apꞌekam ch ed k hab kaij, “Bap chum e elid map d Jiosh alidag. Pegih, ab g hig chehani idam hohodai mat wo e pahnch naptki pi bihugim.”
Kush hab kaij g Jesus, “Pi ant hab wo juh. An o hab chuꞌig Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Jiosh neꞌoki o baꞌich d i si s‑has haꞌichu mo hi g haꞌichu hugi.
Kut g oꞌodham hemho ab wo wa s‑wohog elidad.” Deuteronomy 8:3

content: Kutsh g ge Jiawul am hahawa wuhpuij tahgio i mahsid g geꞌe cheopi. Heg o am kehk amai mo hab e aꞌaga Si Hekia S‑apꞌekam Kihhim ch d Jerusalem.
Kush hab ahg, “Maptp woho d wo Jiosh alidagk, pegih, am g i dahꞌi amjed mo gan hu si uhgk kihtas. No hig pi hab chuꞌig an Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Jiosh at ab wo ha cheha g muꞌi anghil mat wo m‑nuhkud.
Kut an hu wo m‑uꞌukchid mapt nih g shaꞌi e‑tahtad ab hu wo shul hohodai t ab.” Psalm 91:11

content: Sh hab kaij g Jesus ab wui, “Pi ant wo pipꞌich g Jiosh. An o hab chuꞌig oꞌohanaj ed:

content.text: Pi g wo shaꞌi pipꞌichudad g e‑kownalig Jiosh.” Deuteronomy 6:16

content: Kutsh am hahawa wuhpuij tahgio wehs i mahsid g kokownaltalig ch kaistalig jewed dahm
k ab wui hab kaij, “Wehs ant am wo m‑mah ihda maptp ab ni‑wui wo i gehsh k ab wo ni‑ihmad.”
Kush hab kaij g Jesus, “Gam g hu hihm, ahpi ge Jiawul. An o hab chuꞌig Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Heg amt waꞌi Jiosh ab wui wo i gehsh k ab wo ihmad ch heg ab wo waꞌi s‑wohog elidad.” Deuteronomy 6:13

content: Kutsh wa woho gam hu hih g ge Jiawul. Tsh g anghil ab wui hihi g Jesus k am i wehmt.
Matsh g Jesus am i himch g e‑chikpan Galilee chekshani ch ed
Am hu hebai amtsh am kuh hegai John mo am wa ha pahl wapkon. Kutsh am i kah g Jesus mamtsh kuh k atsh gam hu hahawa hih Galilee chekshani wui
k am jiwia Nazareth t ab. K am hema ep d kihhim mo d Capernaum ch an hugidaj an g Galilee kahchki. Kutsh am i dahiwua g Jesus.
Neh, heki atki hu waꞌi oꞌoha g Isaiabad matsh id am hab wo e juh. K hegai oꞌohanaj hab chuꞌig:

content.text: Si haꞌichu at am hab wo e juh Galilee ch ed.
Ihda chekshani o an hab chuꞌig kahchki hugid an ch am huduni tahgio amjed g Jordan akimel.
K an kihdag hegam mo d Zebulonbad amjedkam ch hegam mo d Naphtalibad amjedkam ch hegam ehp mo d gawul mahs hemajkam.
Bo sha mahs mo am dadha s‑chuhugam k ed no ge mahch g Jiosh.
K g muhkig ab ha wui him.
T wabshaba wo nei mat am haꞌichu wo i wuhshani k hab wo sha masmak mo g si geꞌe tonlig. Isaiah 9:1-2

content: Neh, bash wa kaij g Isaiabad.
Kutsh wa woho am i wuhsh g Jesus k am i ahgahi g haꞌichu e‑ahga hab kaijch, “Gam g hu wo s‑ohhod g pi ap e‑chegitoi. E o aihim mat in wo i wuhsh g Jiosh kownaltalig.”
Matsh g Jesus ab haꞌi ha wai g waptopi ha uꞌudam mat wo wehmajk

Sh an him g Jesus Galilee kahchki hugid an. Kush am haꞌi oiopo g waptopi ha uꞌudam ch am wuhpa g chuagia shuhdagi ch ed ch hekaj am ha uꞌu g waptopi. Hema ash d Simon ch hab hahawa e chechcheg Peter. Kush hema d wehngaj ch hab chehgig Andrew. Jesus atsh am i ha nei idam
k hab ha ahg, “Ab g wo i ni‑oid k wo ni‑wehmajkad. Kunt ahni wo em‑mashcha mamt g hemajkam wo i ha wanchkwua am s‑apꞌekam wui.”
Kutsh am ha hekaj wabsh i dagito g e‑chikpan k am i oi.

Tsh am shaꞌi hihi haꞌas huꞌi. Tsh g Jesus am i ha nei idam James ch John. Idam o hab waꞌap d e‑wepngam ch ash am chikpan g e‑ohg wehm wahlko ch ed ch am apꞌechud g e‑chuagia. Tsh g Jesus ab ha wai mat am wo wehmajk.
Kutsh am ha hekaj wabsh i dagito g e‑ohg ch e‑chikpan k am i oi g Jesus.
Mash gam hu ha mihshmdahim g Jesus Galilee chekshani ch ed

Kush idam am hahawa hahasko oiopo Galilee chekshani ch ed. Kush g Jesus am ha mashcham g hemajkam ha‑chechopi ed ch am ha ahgidahim g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahgaj g Jiosh ab amjed g kownaltaligaj ch am ep ha dodajid g nahnko mahs kokꞌodam.

Tsh an wehsko i kaida g haꞌichu ahga ab amjed am Syria jewed ch ed mo heg eda g Galilee d chekshani. Tsh g hemajkam heg hekaj wehs ab ha uꞌapa wui hegam mo nahnko masma kokꞌo ch hegam mo haꞌichukaj e kudut ch hegam mo g jijawul an uꞌukch g ha‑chegitoidag ch hegam mo s‑ha chuhugchud ch hegam mo pi himdag. Tsh g Jesus wehs ha dodaj.

Kutsh g hemajkam wehskojed i hihim k am oid g Jesus. Idam ash haꞌi d Galilee t am oꞌodham ch haꞌi ab amjed mo hab e aꞌaga Wehst‑mahm Kihhim ch haꞌi ab Jerusalem t amjed ch an wehskojed g Judea chekshani k ch haꞌi ga hu aigojed g Jordan akimel.
